utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it starts in the morning, but I don’t know the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know which morning, or is there a contact number for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Glad to hear it. I'll bring the repair drive over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, bring it by and I’ll take a look right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is picking up this afternoon; I heard a few folks already signed up. Pia, I can tell you who’s coordinating it if you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure, I can point you to them if you want.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got a list of what needs fixing if you’re ready to take notes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m ready. Go ahead and list them, and I’ll write everything down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone I can — come by and bring whatever tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that. I’ve got a wrench and a screwdriver I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, bring them by when you can. I’ll let a few more neighbors know we’ve got help coming.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’ll keep you posted on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Just let me know what’s still missing and I’ll handle my part.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Leo. I’ll send you the missing items list shortly, and we can split it up from there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me what needs repairing and when the drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the wiring and a few loose fixtures. The drive starts Saturday morning, and I’ll probably join a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. What time on Saturday should I expect the rest of us there?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can probably help after school pickup, but I need to keep the timing tight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would help a lot. I can line up the first batch and keep it moving so we stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll handle pickup and keep it on a tight clock.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard a little about it second-hand, but people seem to be showing up for the repair drive. Is there anything I should know before I pass it along?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly just that it’s a drop-in repair drive, so folks can bring whatever needs fixing and see what can be patched up. I’d pass along that it’s informal and people should just come by with their items.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that — what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the basics, really - a few loose joints, a leaky faucet, and one wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard folks are organizing the repair drive. I can help if you need a quiet pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Rey. I might forget which wrench is mine, but I can still point you to the stack and keep out of the way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Point me at the stack, and I’ll keep the handoff simple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. I’ll mention it to a few neighbors and see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. I’ll keep an eye on what we’re short on and let you know if I can round up anything too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll keep asking around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along, but I don't have the latest details yet. I'll keep an ear out while I'm out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. Let me know if you hear anything concrete.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll ask around and tell you as soon as I hear something concrete.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to ask Vik what time folks are meeting, but I’ve got the details mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: He told me the repair drive starts at six by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, six by the community hall. I’ll try to keep that straight this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I might've missed the update, but I'm here now—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks. Can you help move the boxes by the curb?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that. Point me to which boxes you want moved first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a few clamps if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: drill, clamps, and a clear start time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I’ll bring the drill and clamps, and I can be there at the start time you pick.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. Let me know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll send over the list of what’s left and where we need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, send it over and I’ll jump in where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word, Opal. What does the repair drive still need most?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We still need big tools and a few people with trucks. If you can spread that we’re collecting drills, ladders, and anyone who can haul debris, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about drills, ladders, trucks, and anyone who can haul debris.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo. I’ve got the repair drive list and I’ll keep it moving so we can match each fix with the right volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and flag anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll coordinate the matches and keep you posted if any supply gaps come up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive, but I’m only getting bits and pieces. What’s the latest from your end?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve only got one clear update so far: the repair drive is happening, but I’m still waiting on the full details. I’ll tell you as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it - I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything clearer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thank you. I can work around school pickup times if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll keep that in mind and work around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that repair drive, Kira. Just tell me what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re talking about the drive itself, right? What exactly still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, the drive itself. I’m talking about the driveway surface, and I can help fix whatever is cracked or uneven.
